description: We are just an all-high schoolers passionate team eager to know more about the universe. If you're constantly looking up at the night sky and asking, "What's out there?" you relate to us. So come and join us on this journey!
summary:
We are more than excited to present our project, "How to make an alien friend.com".
As you can guess, it is a simple, kid-friendly website, aimed to help children learn about and cherish all of NASA's old and abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars, through a short, fun, and compelling story.
details:
Our website tells the story of NASA's abandoned equipment, through the perspective of a human astronaut and his new alien friend, exploring planets and discovering NASA's legacy.
It can be seen as a tribute for all those rovers and machines left behind on missions as soon as their purpose was served, and teaches kids about their impact and how important they were to NASA's research, and how they deserve to be remembered and cherished forever.
Many tools proved to be helpful during the development of this website, most notably the Replit app, which used CSS, HTML, and JavaScript, to build the website, as well as Netlify which displays the site itself. Alongside Aseprite, which we utilized to make all the art you see in the project.
